scripts: create service user ai-practical-assessment-ticketservice with path /home/users/system/ai-practical-assessment

set properties on /content/dam/ai-practical-assessment/jcr:content
  set cq:conf{String} to /conf/ai-practical-assessment
  set jcr:title{String} to "AI Practical Assessment"
end

set ACL for ai-practical-assessment-ticketservice
  allow jcr:read,rep:write on /content/ai-practical-assessment
  allow jcr:all on /content/ai-practical-assessment/tickets
  allow jcr:read on /home/users
  allow jcr:read on /home/groups
end

set ACL for support-user
  allow jcr:read on /content/ai-practical-assessment/tickets
end

set ACL for support-agent
  allow jcr:read,jcr:modifyProperties on /content/ai-practical-assessment/tickets
  allow jcr:addChildNodes on /content/ai-practical-assessment/tickets
  allow jcr:read on /content/ai-practical-assessment/create-ticket
end

set ACL for support-manager
  allow jcr:all on /content/ai-practical-assessment/tickets
end
